initial.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / print typography preview.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an existing ChinaTech repair intake receipt. Refine this exact sheet to feel calmer and less text-dense. Preserve the existing landscape A-series sheet proportions, equal left/right folds, central fold guide, all panel positions and reading order. Return a single complete front-facing high-resolution sheet, not a desk photograph or app screenshot.
LOCKED STRUCTURE: Left = small ChinaTech brand + receipt title, QR at upper right of left fold, order/date/contact, light-gray device/customer card, 3-row quote table with one total row, original scope note, one combined intake/handover box, tracking reminder. Right = light-gray warranty heading strip with separate six-month badge, full five numbered clauses, statutory-rights paragraph, acknowledgment paragraph, bottom light-gray blank signature/date box. Keep all these groups. No new main columns, no moved QR, no new footer banners.
CHANGE ONLY TYPOGRAPHY AND SPACING: Body stays clearly readable and no smaller than reference. Use regular-weight body, lighter muted labels, semibold only for titles, model and total. Increase paragraph separation and provide visible white breathing room between all five clauses; avoid a continuous dark wall of text. Use comfortable consistent line spacing about 1.18–1.23. Make the oversized right heading more economical so it takes no more than two balanced lines and frees room for the full clause text; keep the badge readable and in the same position. Improve natural line breaks and padding within the existing left cards, separate metadata from values and make handover facts easy to scan without long run-on text. Keep table rows airy and consistent. Subtle neutral-gray rules, pale-gray panels, black/gray ink only. Keep complete white paper margins and enough blank signature space. No decorative art, perspective, shadows, color accents or tiny legal print.
CONTENT INVARIANTS: Preserve ALL source fields, prices, dates, original Chinese customer free text, six-month term, copy label, policy version and every legal sentence. Do not remove or summarize fields to create whitespace. Keep 90+60+40=190, use the existing language's monetary formatting. Keep unsigned signature/date lines blank. Preserve the QR artwork visually; the result is a design preview, not an issued business document.
Render all printed words sharply, with correct accents and spelling. The authoritative legal text below MUST appear verbatim, numbered 1–5 plus the two following paragraphs. Do not replace with lorem ipsum or repeat a paragraph.
LANGUAGE: Italian. Keep the original Italian receipt wording and the original customer's Chinese free text.
Full five clauses:
1. La garanzia commerciale copre i difetti di materiale o lavorazione dei componenti sostituiti e dell'intervento effettuato, previa verifica. Il periodo indicato decorre dalla riconsegna effettiva del dispositivo riparato.
2. Esclusi i guasti causati da uso improprio, negligenza, cadute, urti, piegature, pressione, liquidi o corrosione. La causa va verificata; una traccia di danno non esclude automaticamente la tutela di difetti indipendenti.
3. Non sono coperti danni estetici preesistenti estranei all'intervento o guasti causati da successive riparazioni di terzi. Rotture accidentali successive di vetro o display non sono comprese.
4. La garanzia commerciale non comprende software, account, recupero dati, accessori non riparati o componenti non sostituiti. Prima dell'intervento effettuare un backup dei propri dati.
5. Per l'assistenza contattare il negozio indicato, presentando il dispositivo e questo documento. Gli interventi fuori copertura richiedono un preventivo accettato separatamente dal cliente.
Statutory rights: La garanzia commerciale non limita i diritti e i rimedi gratuiti previsti dalla legge, ove applicabili. Nessuna firma su questo documento comporta rinuncia a tali diritti.
Acknowledgment: Confermo di aver verificato i dati di accettazione, il dispositivo, gli accessori, il difetto segnalato e la garanzia commerciale indicata. La firma non attesta pagamento, diagnosi, collaudo o accettazione di un preventivo e non rinuncia ai diritti di legge.
Policy version: repair-intake-2026-10-v1
